scripts.lint: prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json svelte.config.js vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts src scripts/*.ts playwright/*.pw.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json svelte.config.js vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts src scripts/*.ts playwright/*.pw.ts
scripts.test: bun test src/server src/game src/shared src/lib
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch src/server src/game src/shared src/lib
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check && bun test && bun run build && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:performance && bun run verify:production
